steps.name: Test with pytest and coverage
steps.run:
# Live loopback servers can leave event-loop resources pending when
# several transport modules share one hosted-runner process. Run each
# such module in a fresh process and combine their coverage below.
isolated_tests=(
  tests/test_adaptive_transport.py
  tests/test_entity_transport.py
  tests/test_http_pooling.py
  tests/test_mcp_gateway.py
  tests/test_mcp_gateway_lifecycle.py
  tests/test_mcp_gateway_initialization.py
  tests/test_mcp_harness.py
  tests/test_mcp_oauth.py
  tests/test_mcp_oauth_client.py
  tests/test_retrieval_receipts_transport.py
  tests/test_saved_events_transport.py
  tests/test_saved_transport.py
  tests/test_workflow_composition_transport.py
)

pytest -v -o addopts='' -o faulthandler_timeout=60 \
  --cov=slopsearx --cov=engines --cov-report= --cov-fail-under=0 \
  "${isolated_tests[0]}"

for test_file in "${isolated_tests[@]:1}"; do
  pytest -v -o addopts='' -o faulthandler_timeout=60 \
    --cov=slopsearx --cov=engines --cov-append \
    --cov-report= --cov-fail-under=0 "$test_file"
done

ignore_args=()
for test_file in "${isolated_tests[@]}"; do
  ignore_args+=("--ignore=$test_file")
done
pytest -v -o addopts='' -o faulthandler_timeout=60 --durations=10 \
  "${ignore_args[@]}" \
  --cov=slopsearx --cov=engines --cov-append \
  --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=html --cov-fail-under=80

steps.name: Prune untagged versions past retention
steps.run:
# Deployment manifests pin the image by digest (issue #210). A
# re-run of this workflow for the same commit produces a new digest
# under the same short-SHA tag, briefly orphaning the pinned one.
# Retention keeps orphaned digests alive long enough for the
# scheduled image-promotion workflow (or a human) to heal the pin.
echo "Pruning untagged slopsearx versions older than ${RETENTION_DAYS} days"
cutoff="$(date -u -d "-${RETENTION_DAYS} days" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
query=".[] | select((.metadata.container.tags == null or (.metadata.container.tags | length) == 0) and (.created_at < \"${cutoff}\")) | .id"
gh api \
  --method GET \
  "/users/magnus919/packages/container/slopsearx/versions?per_page=100" \
  --jq "$query" \
  | while read -r version_id; do
    echo "  Deleting version $version_id"
    gh api --method DELETE \
      "/users/magnus919/packages/container/slopsearx/versions/$version_id" --silent
  done

steps.name: Install mandatory offline replay isolation
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap apparmor
/usr/bin/bwrap --version
# Same namespace/capability flags as the native runner; no candidate runs here.
replay_setup_probe() {
  /usr/bin/bwrap --unshare-user --unshare-net --unshare-pid --disable-userns \
    --cap-drop ALL --new-session --die-with-parent --ro-bind / / \
    --proc /proc --dev /dev -- /bin/sh -c \
    'cat /proc/self/attr/current; grep "^CapEff:" /proc/self/status; cat /proc/net/dev'
}
sudo cat /sys/kernel/security/apparmor/profiles | grep -E '^(bwrap|unpriv_bwrap)' || true
# Refuse an unexpected executable attachment instead of layering a second profile.
for policy in /etc/apparmor.d/*; do
  if [ -f "$policy" ] && grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*(profile[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+)?/usr/bin/bwrap([[:space:]]|$)' "$policy"; then
    echo "Existing bubblewrap policy: $policy"
    cat "$policy"
    if ! grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*profile[[:space:]]+bwrap[[:space:]]+/usr/bin/bwrap([[:space:]]|$)' "$policy"; then
      echo "Unexpected bwrap attachment identity; refusing policy replacement" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  fi
done
if ! replay_setup_probe; then
  sudo journalctl -k --no-pager -n 100 | grep -E 'apparmor|userns|bwrap' || true
fi
# Purpose-built bwrap setup profile plus capability-denied child stack.
# See docs/rust-rewrite/replay/README.md for upstream policy provenance.
sudo apparmor_parser --replace <<'PROFILE'
abi <abi/4.0>,
include <tunables/global>
profile bwrap /usr/bin/bwrap flags=(attach_disconnected,mediate_deleted) {
  capability,
  file rwlkm /{**,},
  network,
  unix,
  ptrace,
  signal,
  userns,
  mount,
  umount,
  pivot_root,
  dbus,
  pix /** -> &bwrap//&ssx_replay_unpriv,
}
profile ssx_replay_unpriv flags=(attach_disconnected,mediate_deleted) {
  file rwlkm /{**,},
  network,
  unix,
  ptrace,
  signal,
  userns,
  mount,
  umount,
  pivot_root,
  dbus,
  pix /** -> &ssx_replay_unpriv,
  audit deny capability,
}
PROFILE
replay_setup_probe

  if [ -n "$server_pid" ]; then
    if kill -0 "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
      printf 'STOP\n' >&3 2>/dev/null || true
      for attempt in $(seq 1 50); do
        if ! kill -0 "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi
        sleep 0.1

      if kill -0 "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null; then kill -TERM "$server_pid"; fi
      for attempt in $(seq 1 20); do

      if kill -0 "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null; then kill -KILL "$server_pid"; fi

    exec 3>&- || true
    wait "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true

  fi
  if [ -n "$fifo" ]; then rm -f "$fifo"; fifo=""; fi
  if [ -n "$stem" ]; then rm -f "$stem.log" "$stem.calls"; stem=""; fi

    sleep 0.1
  done
  if [ -z "$ready" ]; then echo "native fixture startup timed out" >&2; cat "$log" >&2; return 1; fi
  local address
  address="$(sed -n 's/.*"address":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$log" | head -n 1)"
  if [ -z "$address" ]; then echo "native fixture did not publish its loopback address" >&2; cat "$log" >&2; return 1; fi
  local output
  if output="$(PORTAL_NATIVE_HTML_THEME_SMOKE=1 \
      PORTAL_NATIVE_HTML_BASE_URL="http://$address/" \
      PORTAL_NATIVE_HTML_DEFAULT_THEME="$theme" \
      python -m pytest --no-cov -q tests/test_native_html_theme_browser.py 2>&1)"; then
    :
  else
    local result=$?
    printf '%s\n' "$output"
    return "$result"
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$output"
  if ! printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -Eq '^1 passed(, [0-9]+ warnings?)? in [0-9.]+s$'; then
    echo "expected exactly one passing native theme browser test" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  if printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -Eq 'skipped'; then
    echo "native theme browser test must not skip" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  if [ ! -e "$calls" ] || [ -s "$calls" ]; then
    echo "theme landing/toggle requests unexpectedly dispatched a search" >&2
    if [ -e "$calls" ]; then cat "$calls" >&2; fi
    return 1
  fi
  printf 'STOP\n' >&3
  for attempt in $(seq 1 50); do
    if ! kill -0 "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi
    sleep 0.1
  done
  if kill -0 "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "native fixture did not stop after STOP" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  exec 3>&-
  if ! wait "$server_pid"; then echo "native fixture exited unsuccessfully" >&2; return 1; fi
  server_pid=""
  rm -f "$fifo" "$log" "$calls"
  fifo=""
  stem=""
}
